title: 赶飞机
setting: Beijing, the Third Ring Road, 7:20 am.

driver.name: 师傅
driver.en: a Beijing cabbie with a jar of tea

steps.narr: Your flight boards at eight. It's 7:20. You leap into a taxi. ⏱️
steps.zh: 早上七点二十，八点就要登机了，你刚跳上出租车。

say.en: Tell him: Capital Airport, you've got a flight to catch!
answers: 师傅，去首都机场！我赶飞机！
say.gloss: Capital Airport, please! I've got a flight to catch!
say.tip: 师傅 shīfu: what you call any driver. 赶飞机 gǎn fēijī = to rush for a flight.

mistakes.note: 司机 is the job title. To his face, a driver is 师傅.

ok.en: Got a flight, eh? What time?

miss.zh: 不说话？看您这箱子，去机场吧？
miss.en: Not talking? With that suitcase, it's the airport, right?

1.tip: 去 + a place = (take me) to…: all a taxi needs to hear. 师傅 shīfu: what you call any driver.

3.en: Tell him: Capital Airport, and ask him nicely to hurry.
answers: 师傅，去首都机场，麻烦快点儿！
师傅，首都机场，我赶时间！
去机场，麻烦您开快点儿！
师傅，去机场，能快点儿吗？
3.gloss: Capital Airport, please, and would you mind hurrying?
3.tip: 麻烦 máfan + a request = would you mind…: the soft way to ask anyone for anything. 快点儿 = a bit faster; 赶时间 = I'm in a hurry.

say.en: Boarding's at eight. Tell him you're nearly out of time!
answers: 八点的飞机，要来不及了！
say.gloss: Boarding's at eight, I'm almost out of time!
say.tip: 来不及了 láibují le = there's no time left. The hopeful version: 来得及 = there's still time.

mistakes.note: 迟到 is late for class or work. For a flight: 来不及了, or 赶不上飞机.
来得及 and 赶得上 mean there's still time. Out of time is 来不及, or 赶不上.

ok.zh: 前方道路拥堵，预计还需四十分钟。
ok.en: Heavy traffic ahead. Forty minutes to your destination.

fail.en: What time? Don't panic, take it slow.

miss.zh: 不着急是吧？那我慢慢开。
miss.en: No rush, then? I'll take it easy.

3.en: Boarding's at eight. Tell him one more jam and you've had it!
answers: 八点登机，再堵就来不及了！
再堵下去，就赶不上飞机了！
八点的飞机，再堵车就来不及了！
师傅，再堵就真来不及了！
3.gloss: Boarding's at eight. Any more traffic and I've had it!
3.tip: 再…就… = any more…and…: 再堵就来不及了 = one more jam and I'm out of time. 堵 dǔ = jammed; 堵车 = a traffic jam.

steps.zh: 急也没用！我跟您说，我开了三十年出租……
steps.en: No use panicking! Let me tell you, I've been driving a cab for thirty years...

say.en: Cut in: ask him to take the expressway!
say.tip: 走 zǒu = take (a route): 走高速 = take the expressway. 咱们 zánmen is a 'we' that includes him: friendly.

mistakes.note: The expressway is 高速 gāosù (short for 高速公路), and you take it with 走: 走高速.

alts.en: Or: tell him to cut through the back streets
alts.gloss: Take a shortcut, use the back streets!

then.zh: 抄近道？您胆儿够大的！坐稳了！
then.en: Back streets? You've got nerve! Hold on tight!

then.narr: He swings into a lane barely wider than the taxi. A man on a tricycle flattens himself against a wall.
then.zh: 车拐进一条窄路，骑三轮的大爷赶紧贴墙站好。

ok.en: Right you are, expressway it is! Hold on tight!

fail.zh: ……那会儿四环外头还是庄稼地呢……
fail.en: ...back then, past the Fourth Ring it was all cornfields...

miss.en: ...and then the Third Ring started jamming too...
Forty minutes of Beijing traffic history later, your gate has closed. ✈️
miss.zh: 北京交通史讲完了，登机口也关了。

3.en: Cut in politely: ask him to take the expressway.
answers: 师傅，打断一下，咱们走高速吧！
不好意思，师傅，咱走高速吧！
师傅，不好意思，能走高速吗？
打断一下，咱们走机场高速吧！
3.gloss: Sorry to cut in, but let's take the expressway!
3.tip: 打断一下 dǎduàn yíxià = sorry to cut in: how you stop anyone mid-story without being rude. 走高速 = take the expressway.

steps.zh: 您这么急，怎么不早点儿出门啊？
steps.en: If you're in such a rush, why didn't you leave earlier?

say.en: You've no breath for that story. Tell him it's a long one.
answers: 说来话长，您专心开车吧！
say.gloss: It's a long story. You just focus on driving!
say.tip: 说来话长 = it's a long story. 一言难尽 = too much to put in a word. Both close a topic politely.

mistakes.note: 'Long story' isn't 长故事 in Chinese. Say 说来话长.

ok.en: Haha, I get it. Overslept, didn't you?

fail.en: Hm? Go on, tell me. We're stuck anyway.

miss.zh: 不想说？那我接着说我的。
miss.en: Don't want to say? Then back to my story.

3.en: You've no breath for that story. Tell him it's a long one, for another time.
answers: 说来话长，回头再跟您说吧！
唉，一言难尽，下次再聊吧！
3.gloss: It's a long story. I'll tell you another time!
3.tip: 回头再说 = (we'll talk about it) later: the polite way to put any topic off. 说来话长 = it's a long story.

steps.narr: 7:52. Terminal 3 looms out of the haze. ✈️
steps.zh: 七点五十二，三号航站楼到了。

steps.en: Here we are! Off you go, safe travels!

steps.narr: Your phone buzzes. A text from the airline: your flight is delayed by two hours. 📱
steps.zh: 手机响了。航空公司发来短信：航班延误两个小时。

say.en: Groan: if you'd known, you wouldn't have rushed like that.
answers: 早知道就不用这么赶了！
say.gloss: If I'd known, I wouldn't have rushed like this!
say.tip: 早知道…… = if I'd known (sooner)...: the go-to chunk for hindsight. 慢慢来 = take it slow.

alts.en: Or: ask the driver if he fancies carrying on the chat
alts.gloss: How about we carry on chatting?

then.zh: 哈哈！上车，咱从一九九五年聊起！
then.en: Ha! Hop in. We'll start from 1995!

ok.zh: 延误了？嘿，那上车，咱接着聊！
ok.en: Delayed? Ha! Hop back in, then. We'll carry on chatting!

miss.en: Hey, stop staring into space. Hop in!

1.tip: 早知道就好了 = if only I'd known: hindsight in one breath.

3.en: Groan: if you'd known about the delay, you'd never have rushed like that.
answers: 早知道延误，就不用这么赶了！
早知道晚点，我就不着急了！
早知道延误，我就慢慢来了！
早知道飞机晚点，就不赶了！
3.gloss: If I'd known it'd be delayed, I wouldn't have rushed like this!
3.tip: 早知道 + what you didn't know, 就 + what you'd have done. 延误 yánwù = (a flight) delayed; 晚点 = running late.

steps.en: Two hours, one jar of tea, and the complete history of Beijing, from the Second Ring Road to the Sixth.
steps.zh: 两个小时，从二环聊到了六环。
